sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 200. Success value 80. 5x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 50 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 60. Confuses for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies beast (increases ATK and MATK by 60%; removes debuffs; removes status ailments; and applies a ward) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 7000
Time-elemental defense from Unison Damage increased by 150.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 7000
